issues.title: [DRAFT] EWM2: do not re-display revoked owner facts in fallback race (#227 follow-up)
issues.body:
## Security and owner-consent follow-up for EWM2 integration (#227)

**Stacked on #227**, starting at head `f5881a7b5ba6894f36df38eb28f897cb4da1cda5`. Only two existing files touched: `ContinuumBrain.kt` and `ContinuumBrainBridgeTest.kt`. No changes to the original research (#224), TEST4/TEST5, the model, personal data, APK signing or `main`.

### 1. Revoked memory in the fallback race
Previously, if an owner fact was revoked between baseline rendering and EWM2's active-facts check, `FALLBACK_REVOKED` returned **that stale baseline text** unchanged. It could display the revoked fact.

Now it returns a neutral `NO_EVIDENCE_ANSWER`, no owner IDs, `grounded=false`, and source `NONE`. The regression test creates a deterministic baseline containing a cited fact, revokes that fact at the race hook, and asserts the output never re-displays it.

### 2. Owner switches EWM2 OFF while a turn is running
The brain originally sampled `ON` only at turn start. Turning it OFF mid-turn could still publish an ON answer afterward.

Now the owner mode is re-read before publishing the ON result. If switched OFF/SHADOW, the pre-existing baseline is used. The stronger revoked-memory redaction still has priority if both events coincide. A dedicated concurrency regression test covers OFF in flight.

### Quality boundaries
**NOT_RUN**: tests were added but an Android/JUnit/Gradle run is unavailable from the GitHub connector. Review and run the targeted `ContinuumBrainBridgeTest`, all EWM-equivalence tests and full regression before adoption. This fix reduces two concrete races; it does **not** certify all possible revocation races through UI publication.

Keep EWM2 default OFF, validate SHADOW on the Fold7 before owner authorization for ON. No automatic merge.

issues.title: [DRAFT / NOT_RUN] Rescue: preserve LEX2 BOM and cap retained failed output
issues.body:
Two narrow source defects affect the existing Generation16 rescue helper:

1. A valid Kotlin LEX2 string starting U+FEFF was decoded with TextDecoder's default BOM stripping, causing a false record-hash mismatch. ignoreBOM:true preserves the field bytes' meaning while fatal malformed-UTF8 refusal remains enabled.
2. Node spawnSync checks maxBuffer after appending a complete read chunk. A failed child's returned stdout can exceed512KiB+1; the old helper saved that entire buffer. Retained failed output now explicitly uses at most512KiB+1 bytes, records captureDetails returnedBytes/retainedBytes/truncated, and keeps the original CAPTURE_1_FAILED status. No overflow is accepted as a valid capture.

Baseline: PR218 final0b2a9dddfe172eac82923092fcdaa974afc6e25a. Source/test commit:5d99eda49c15a831afc5da643eb6d8dc45ea42b5. Final handoff checkpoint:40b58a7e691ce3a3fefe198743dcfc1d4d4febda.
